Anonymous post for another group member
Hi, I would like to ask an anonymous question. If any of you have gone through a similar situation, I would really appreciate your experience. I have been living in Israel for 7 years, and I have an A5 visa. I got pregnant this year, and my due date will be in October. I would like to bring two of my family members from Colombia to Israel to help me during the days of the birth and in the first few months after I have the baby. I don’t know how to start the process. If anyone could share their experience, I would really appreciate knowing what steps to take, what paperwork I need, and how you think the process will go. Thank you so much, everyone!”
